{{disambig|Necromancer}}

==Towers==
'''Necromancer''' may refer to these towers:
*[[Necromancer]], a tower that spawns gravestones which turn into skeletons with its ability
**[[Necromancer/Gallery]]
**[[Necromancer/History]]

==Enemies==
'''Necromancer''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Molten Necromancer]], a summoner enemy that first appears on Wave 20 in [[Molten Mode]]
**[[Molten Necromancer/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Necromancer]], a summoner enemy that first appears on Wave 20 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Necromancer/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)]], a summoner enemy that first appears in multiple modes
**[[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Necromancer King]], a high health summoner enemy that first appears on Wave 23 in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]
**[[Necromancer King/Advanced Stats]]

It can also refer to these removed enemies:
*[[Dark Necromancer]], a summoner enemy that first appears on Wave 19 in [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode and in the [[Legion (Challenge)|Legion]] and [[Juggernaut (Challenge)|Juggernaut]] challenges, and on Wave 23 in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode
**[[Dark Necromancer/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)]], a summoner enemy that first appears on Wave 19 in [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] mode
*[[Necromancer 2]], a summoner enemy that first appeared on Wave 37 prior to the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]]
*[[Necromancer Boss]], a high health summoner enemy that first appeared on Wave 46 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode

It can also refer to these event enemies:
*[[Frost Necromancer (Frost Invasion)]], a high health summoner enemy that first appeared on Wave 19 in the [[Frost Invasion Event]]
*[[Frost Necromancer]], a high health summoner enemy that first appeared on Wave 24 on Easy difficulty and Wave 32 on Hard difficulty in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]
**[[Frost Necromancer/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Korblox Necromancer]], a high health summoner enemy that first appeared on Wave 15 on Impossible difficulty in [[The Hunt: Mega Edition Event]]
*[[Null Necromancer]], a high health summoner enemy that first appeared on Wave 27 in [[Blind Faith]]
**[[Null Necromancer/Advanced Stats]]

==Skins==
'''Necromancer''' may refer to these skins:
*[[Crook Boss/Gallery|{{Color|Halloween|Necromancer}} Crook Boss]] skin
**[[Pistol Goon/Gallery|{{Color|Halloween|Necromancer}} Pistol Goon]]
**[[Tommy Goon 1/Gallery|{{Color|Halloween|Necromancer}} Tommy Goon 1]]
**[[Tommy Goon 2/Gallery|{{Color|Halloween|Necromancer}} Tommy Goon 2]]

==Other==
'''Necromancer''' may also refer to:
*[[Necromancer's Tome (Consumable)]]
*[[Necromancer's Tome (Emote)]]
*[[Null Necromancer Charm]]
*[[Roblox Mystery Figure - Necromancer Boss|Necromancer Boss]] toy, based on the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode [[Necromancer Boss]]
